name: HDR Gaussian Splatting
definition: A framework for 3D HDR imaging that renders novel HDR views and reconstructs LDR images with user-controllable exposure time, using a Dual Dynamic Range (DDR) Gaussian point cloud model and two Parallel Differentiable Rasterization (PDR) processes.
summary: HDR Gaussian Splatting is a 3D imaging framework that renders novel HDR views and reconstructs LDR images with user-controllable exposure using a Dual Dynamic Range Gaussian point cloud and parallel rasterization.
